drafted_from: tool:read-sharing-state row and its do-work file; read it before relying on it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Say whether my decisions are shared anonymously and what my stories published total is." It runs tool:read-sharing-state and answers the sharing and stories state.
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes the records it is given and answers, and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Say whether my decisions are shared anonymously and what my stories published total is."
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:read-sharing-state and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: sharing on or off, whether it is your choice or the default, the day the default began, and the pool count (or null when it could not be read).
4. Nothing is kept by this read.

worked_examples.title: Read my sharing and stories on its own sample
worked_examples.ask: Say whether my decisions are shared anonymously.
worked_examples.hands_back: It answered sharing with on true, chosen false, from_day 2026-09-28 and shared_so_far 12.
